additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456807-DC/Si-D/HU-[RVP / T7 170004940] Cable issue CRM:03056000241
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Thank you for reaching out to us regarding this issue.
First, the charger is running on the latest version. Could the customer try again to see if the issue persists? If they do notice the problem again, please ask them to provide the exact timestamp of the action they performed so I can check the logs.
Regarding the converter: the fast shutdown was not performed on this unit. Please check the fast shutdown cable, and if it’s not working, proceed with replacing it.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
Please d
o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body: This case have been solved by FW update. The supposed cable issue was related to other symptoms. This ticket can be closed.
